open_items: All future validators/commands must use this diagnostic boundary.
Optional strict lint execution, full source inventory and complete target runtime matrix remain separately evidenced.
Human presentation/documentation is not an automated oracle (TD-001).

oracle.requirement_contract: Die globale Option `--fail-on error\|warning` MUSS bestimmen, ab welcher Schwere ein Prüfkommando fehlschlägt.
oracle.scope: Shared finding model, semantic ordering and explicit fail assessment; no full CLI command, unknown producer authentication or automatic optional lint.

preconditions: Explicit diagnostic data and already loaded, source-bound model reports.
steps: Construct and validate findings; preserve all observed machine locations and identities.
Apply an explicit threshold without rerunning rules and inspect structured counts and failure class.
